title: Unify proration entropy correction with usage seed signatures for deterministic billing exports
creator: Ava Chen
description: Summary: Over the past quarter we have observed non-deterministic small invoice deltas (~0.5% of invoices) caused by variability in how mid-cycle usage is apportioned across overlapping meter intervals, combined with jitter from downstream export retries. This ticket scopes a deterministic correction path that supplements the existing export pipeline with a compact usage 'seed signature' and an entropy-correction step for proration ratios so that the Stripe export and NetSuite ingestion produce stable, repeatable invoice lines even under retry / concurrency.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Billing export records include a stable seed_signature field derived from deterministic hash(seed fields) and present in both Stripe and NetSuite exports.
2) Reconciliation runner can detect and auto-correct proration_ratio drift when seed_signature matches but invoice deltas exist; corrections must be tracked as idempotent adjustment lines.

3) Golden test dataset (1000 synthetic tenants with varying mid-cycle plan changes and DST edge cases) produces identical Stripe export file across 5 repeated runs (bitwise identical CSV) after changes are applied.
4) Production shadow run on a copy of last 7 days' exports shows <= 0.01% change in invoice totals after corrections, with all changes accompanied by audit logs and adjustment reason codes.
5) Observability: dashboard added showing pre/post reconciliation delta histogram, and an alert when >0.1% of customers would see a material (> $5) invoice change in a shadow run.
notes: Root cause hypothesis: fractional allocation is sensitive to ordering of hourly aggregation and transient retry deduplication; identical usage can be split differently depending on export leader timing and retry load.
Seed signature design: include (tenant_id, meter_key, hour_bucket_start_utc, plan_version, export_epoch) then run SHA256 and take first 16 hex chars to keep export payload small.
Entropy correction: compute canonical proration_ratio by applying deterministic rounding policy seeded by seed_signature bits to break ties consistently across runs.

Trade-offs: adding seed_signature increases export size and requires NetSuite mapping changes, but avoids downstream heuristics and manual adjustments. Alternative was post-import ML matching, which is brittle and opaque.
Rollback plan: feature gate via export flag; if downstream ingestion fails, revert flag within 15 minutes and run automated repair to revert audit-tagged adjustment lines.
